name: BSP_Game_UpdatePresenceContext
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = game, no arguments; sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4def, unconditional. Takes the wall clock from the frame clock object 01090ab0 through its vtable +20h, which returns two int64s that 004c01a5 divides on the x87 stack (ticks over frequency), compares the result against the last stamp in 00e18b30, and returns until 3.0 s (00d7a2b0) have elapsed. Past that it publishes Xbox LIVE presence through XUserSetContext (00a4d3f2) and XUserSetContextEx (00a4d41c), including context id 8001h, using game+5D4h, game+1FE4h and game+218Ch. Second independent confirmation that 01090ab0 is the frame clock object whose +4h field the game update accumulates. docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md.

Constructor 00aa5d70 leaves +0x4c, +0x50, +0x54, +0x58 and +0x74..+0x84 uninitialised and 00aa5e20 fills exactly those. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md; reports/app_init_fonts_gui.json.

name: BSP_DiagnosticSink_GetOrCreate
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __cdecl f(void) returning DAT_0109cf14, RET, body 004c14c0-004c1569. Double-checked lazy singleton whose construction is inlined to one store: 00bf681b(4) then *p = &PTR_LAB_00ce752c, so the object has no state beyond its vtable pointer. The vtable at 00ce752c is one slot, the scalar deleting destructor 004bbca0, which nulls the global and restores base vtable 00ce3818; no RTTI. All 20 call sites discard the result and each follows a formatted message (vsprintf_s in 004c7070, the profiler line '%s %.2f ms count:%d' in 00be3bf0) or a failed precondition (BSP_D3D9IndexBuffer_Lock, BSP_D3D9VertexBuffer_Lock), with five consecutive no-op calls in 0093ff10. Read as a diagnostic sink whose reporting method the shipped build compiled away; the output path is not recoverable from this image. Called at 0073e14b, one instruction after the 'After InitGui' checkpoint. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_FONTS_GUI.md; reports/app_init_fonts_gui.json.

name: BSP_InputAction_WasPressedThisFrame
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Reads the input singleton from 004bec00 (cache 00f8bbf8, constructor 00a93da0), indexes instance+4 with a 30h stride by the argument, and returns 1 when +28h is nonzero, +24h is greater than zero and either +20h is zero or +1Ch is not greater than zero. The +1Ch/+20h pair mirrors the +24h/+28h pair, so the test is a rising edge: held now with positive hold time and not held with positive hold time before. Thirty-two call sites pass different constant indices; application frame 00737a50 passes 0Eh at 00737ae7 and that action is unidentified. cdecl, one stack argument, RET, boolean in AL. Evidence: docs/APP_RUN_FRAME.md and reports/app_run_frame_audit.json. Read-only audit; no ABI-compatible implementation or runtime validation claim.

name: BSP_WideString_Resize
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. thiscall(this, uint new_length, bool preserve), wide counterpart of BSP_NativeString_Resize (0041dd40). Returns immediately when the length is unchanged, so resize(0) on a fresh {0,0} object leaves the data pointer null; new_length 0 frees through the sized pool with length*2+2. Sole callee of BSP_WideString_ConstructFromCString. docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md

name: BSP_WideString_ConstructFromCString
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. thiscall(this, const char*), RET 4, returns this. Wide string object is {uint length at +0; wchar_t* data at +4}. Zeroes both fields, measures strlen, calls BSP_WideString_Resize(len, preserve=1), then zero-extends each byte into the buffer including the terminator. This is not MultiByteToWideChar: bytes above 0x7f pass through unconverted. Used at 008f8288 to widen the Game Explorer GDF path. docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md

name: BSP_Game_ScaleFrameDelta
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = game, one stack argument holding a float*, RET 4; sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4d45, which passes the address of its own delta slot (lea eax,[esp+48h]) so the routine rewrites the caller's delta. Writes game+21ECh (undilated step), game+64Ch (+= step) and game+21F0h (the scaled delta the simulation reads). game+1FE4h picks the path: 0 jumps to 004c6f3d; 2 takes the split path; otherwise 004c6e50 counts eight local-player slots at game+18CCh (pointer non-null, +8h set, +9h clear) and splits when more than one is active. Non-zero modes first apply 007713a0 (ECX = game+1EF0h) in state 0Dh, then clamp to 0.25f (00ce3868) unless 00f876b0 is set. Split path multiplies by 00e0b6c8 (ships 1.0f) and returns. Single path clamps above 00d7a270 (the double promotion of 0.05f) to 0.05f (00ce7638), then scales game+21F0h only by 10.0 (00ce3dc0), 30.0 (00ce7630) or 0.3 (00ce3dc8) for the first held input action among 9, 10 and 12, and finally zeroes it when game+634h is set, with action 11 pressed releasing one 1/30 s step (00ce7628). x87 listing, not pseudocode: the multipliers are 64-bit. docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md.
